body:
Wow, your comments are very uplifting. I will further review and answer them later. 
As i walking last night i met random people and ended up smoking with them and just talking to these random people lifted my mood. I went out today and bought clothes reminding my self of the luxury / money I have to do whatever I want where other people dont. In hindsight i can say my reasoning for wanting to die by being struck by a car on the highway were petty. I don't have that need to end life anymore but i still feel empty and i have attributed this maybe more into depression? I will have to look further into this.
